aggregation_pass_rule: planner, generator, and evaluator are captured, deterministic links are resolved, and evaluator has top-level RESULT: PASS

roles.prompt_template: Plan the scoped work, identify constraints and acceptance gates, and do not edit files.
Generate the scoped artifact or no-op confirmation according to the planner constraints.
Evaluate the generated artifact against acceptance gates and report top-level RESULT: PASS only if no blocking issue remains.
